critical_code_review_comments: Backend design_requests.list_requests uses q['revision_count'] = {'$gte': N} — clean and integrates with pagination + summary, good.

Consider exposing similar server-side min_revision filter on /api/rnd/samples (client-side filter today via sampleRevisionCount) for consistency & to avoid client-side counting drift when pagination/large datasets arrive.
